prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1355; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed the first notice of loss for the left-turn collision. Insured reports the claimant's vehicle struck the rear quarter panel while the insured was completing a left turn at an intersection. Police report requested. Liability appears disputed pending scene evidence.

Entry 2: Spoke with insured by phone. Insured states the oncoming vehicle was traveling fast and the signal had changed. Recorded statement obtained and filed. Photos of both vehicles received and added to the file.

Entry 3: Claimant is represented by counsel. Letter of representation received. All further contact to go through the attorney's office. Requested medical authorization and prior treatment records for the neck and upper back.

Entry 4: Claimant reports whiplash symptoms and has started physical therapy. Medical bills submitted to the file are under review. Independent medical review scheduled. Reserve adjusted to reflect the injury claim and the representation.

Entry 5: Attorney demand package received, including treatment summary and wage loss documentation. Liability position still under review. Supervisor notified of the demand. Next step is to complete the comparative fault analysis and respond to counsel within the required timeframe.
